items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Leonard was involved in all of them [recording sessions]... I received a letter from Leonard Feather, and wanting to know if I would be interested in coming to London to arrange for the BBC dance orchestra

ctx.x: Right. Then you -- at the end of these tours, you always went back to London and you made a number of recording sessions there with Vocalion I think, a new label, and Leonard Feather, I think, was involved in some of those.
Well, I think Leonard was involved in all of them.
